description: This file defines a reusable Checkbox component using React, Radix UI primitives, and Lucide icons. It customizes the appearance and behavior of a checkbox with styling and integrates an icon indicator when checked.

methods.name: Checkbox
methods.description: React functional component that renders a customizable checkbox using Radix UI primitives and applies styling with utility classes. It accepts props for className and other React component props, and renders a CheckIcon when checked.
